_about: Plain-language What's new cards for the ADMIN page only (admin/news.mjs). The client dashboards read CHANGELOG.md's [client] lines and never this file. One entry per version: summary (one line) and items (type new | improved | fixed, tag client | internal, text). A version missing here falls back to wording made from CHANGELOG.md.

1.12.0.summary: The admin page has the new LFMP look, and New firm can use the LeadPro app instead of a pasted token.

items.text: New firm → "Use the LeadPro app" (recommended): no token to create or paste. It makes and saves the dashboard passphrase, starts the same setup the Sub-account Builder uses, and shows each step. Retry only finishes what's missing.
Firm list: a summary strip, filters (Needs attention, App, Private Integration, Tests) and search by name, slug or GHL name.
New look: dark and light themes, the gold LFMP style and the same top bar as the builder. Auto · Light · Dark keeps your choice.
Edit mapping shows each stage as a short chip, with Save mapping at the top.
What's new is now this side panel, with plain summaries and the technical notes one click away.

1.11.2.summary: A sync started while another one was running could fail to save. Fixed.

items.text: A Re-sync or a new firm's first sync that had to wait for another sync no longer fails at the save step.

1.11.1.summary: New firms from the builder could stop while reading GHL. Fixed.

items.text: A new firm from the Sub-account Builder no longer stops at "Read the sub-account's pipelines and stages".

1.11.0.summary: The Sub-account Builder can set up a KPI dashboard by itself.

items.text: New firms from the Sub-account Builder: no token to paste. It never adds two firms for one sub-account.
Stage-mapping presets: firms made from the LFMP template snapshots get their stages mapped automatically.
The "KPI Dashboard" menu link can be added to the firm's GHL sub-account automatically.
When the stages had to be guessed, the bell shows "Review mapping" until Edit mapping is saved.

1.10.0.summary: Firms can get their GHL token from the LeadPro Connector app, refreshed every hour.

items.text: Token keeper: firms set up through the app get a fresh GHL token every hour. Private Integration firms are never touched.
The bell warns when the token keeper hasn't run, the app needs reconnecting or isn't on a sub-account.
Each firm shows Token: App or Token: Private Integration.

1.9.0.summary: Simpler funnel for firms that sign on the first call; renaming a stage in GHL can't break a mapping.

items.text: Funnel simplified for firms that sign on the first call.
Stages can be saved by their GHL id, so renaming a stage in GHL keeps the mapping working.
Funnel steps can be hidden per firm (Mahdavi hides the consult steps).

1.8.0.summary: The LeadPro logo is on the dashboards.

items.text: LeadPro logo added; date line tidied.

1.7.1.summary: More detail on how contacts outside a pipeline came in.

items.text: Each sync records how new contacts outside a pipeline came in (form, chat, booking, call, text, email). Counts only.

1.7.0.summary: Dashboards say which pipeline New leads counts, and the admin page flags contacts outside a pipeline.

items.text: Under New leads: which pipeline it counts, and why someone never added to it isn't counted.
Hover explanations open with a tap on phones, tablets and inside GoHighLevel.
Firm list and bell: new contacts in the last 30 days that aren't in any pipeline.

1.6.1.summary: A read-only check for missing leads.

items.text: "Diagnose missing leads" workflow: counts only, changes nothing.

1.6.0.summary: The bell: sync problems listed with what to do.

items.text: Bell with a count of new sync issues, each with what happened, numbered steps and fix buttons.
Update token checks all 9 scopes before replacing a firm's token.
Firm rows show OK, Held or Failed and the GHL sub-account name.
The "may be incomplete" note clears when the counts recover, or after 24 hours.
Sync chain: each sync starts the next one, because GitHub skips many scheduled runs.
Firm list shows the last update time and warns when it's over 2 hours old.

1.4.0.summary: Call and message numbers no longer dip between updates.

items.text: Missed calls, speed to first contact and contact rate no longer dip when GHL returns only part of the history.
Each channel is pulled two or three times and combined; a short pull holds the previous numbers for up to 3 syncs.

1.3.1.summary: A read-only check of GHL's message export.

items.text: "Diagnose message export" workflow: counts and timings only.

1.3.0.summary: No-shows count as booked consults that were missed.

items.text: A lead in a no-show stage now counts under Consult booked and No-shows.
New firm pre-selects every pipeline with 3 or more funnel stages.
Saving an unchanged mapping leaves config.json exactly as it was.

1.2.0.summary: What's new on the dashboards and the admin page.

items.text: "How this works" has a What's new section; the footer shows the version.
The admin page shows the full changelog.

1.1.0.summary: Shared settings live in one place.

items.text: Targets, banner and other shared settings are set once for all firms; each firm keeps only its own values.

1.0.0.summary: One repo and one admin page for every firm.

items.text: Every firm's scorecard has its own address and shows its practice area.
Refresh data is now Reload; dashboards update from GoHighLevel every 30 minutes.
Admin page: password lock, firm list, New firm with stage mapping, retry and clean-up.
Single-firm syncs no longer lose data.
